story.summary: Irma Thomas's "Anyone Who Knows What Love Is Will Understand" reached #52 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Anyone Who Knows What Love Is (Will Understand)" is a 1964 R&B song written by Jeannie Seely, Randy Newman, Judith Arbuckle and Pat Sheeran. story.fullStory:
Irma Thomas's "Anyone Who Knows What Love Is Will Understand" reached #52 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Anyone Who Knows What Love Is (Will Understand)" is a 1964 R&B song written by Jeannie Seely, Randy Newman, Judith Arbuckle and Pat Sheeran.

The song peaked at #52 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 6 weeks on the chart.
